units.CASHTAKE:
虚拟夺钱单位当其转移所属方时，新所属方将会被一次性夺走此单位的ProduceCashStartup属性所规定的金额，最多可将所属方金额夺取到0。ProduceCashStartup的值需为负值。一般在地图中此单位在转移所属方后必须销毁，以免造成Bug。
While the owner of this unit changed, the cash of new owner will be taked off at once and the specific amount is defined by the property ProduceCashStartup of this unit, the cash of new owner can be taked off to 0 at most. The value of ProduceCashStartup must be negative. Generally, this unit must be destroyed after the owner changed or it may cause some bug.
units.CASHGIVE:
虚拟给钱单位此单位和“虚拟夺钱单位”有着相似的功能，当其所属方转移后新的所属方将会获得参数ProduceCashStartup所规定的金额，但和“虚拟夺钱单位”不同的是，ProduceCashStartup应设为一个正数。为了避免可能的错误，此单位也应该在所属方转移后销毁掉。
This unit have a similar function to the unit 'Dummy Cash Take', it will give the new owner amount of cash limited by the key ProduceCashStartup. But defferent from 'Dummy Cash Take', the key ProduceCashStartup must be a positive number. To keep out of the bug, it's also should be destroyed after owner changed.
